column1: # Firewall-authority decision table (v1.235, owner 2026-10-10): may NFTBan write firewall rules now?
# Read by the Go test (state.FirewallAuthority) AND the shell test (nftban_firewall_authority in
# lib/service_control.sh); both must give the same answer for every row.
# "-" = empty field. lock live = the kernel lock table holds a FLOCK on installer.lock by the PID in
# it; stale = the lock file names a PID but the kernel holds no such lock (dead installer).
